payload.body: Supported Codex lifecycle path is the native hooks framework (hooks feature stable/enabled locally): SessionStart and synchronous SessionEnd provide the opaque session id on stdin, so integration uses no provider transcript scan or filesystem polling. User-installed Codex hooks require one-time host review via /hooks; Claude Code hooks activate from user settings. Standalone hosts without that payload remain mailbox-only.
